correctness.rationale: Exact reindexing of Deng--Fu Lemma 2.1 yields q_j=m^2 sum T(ell/m-1)T(j-k ell/m). The composite trapezoid O(m^-2) error for each fixed piecewise-quadratic summand yields the normalized polynomial with O(m^-2) coefficient error and explicitly integrated coefficients. The limiting factorization has simple roots beta and beta^-1 and double kth roots of unity; quantitative Rouche gives O(m^-2) and O(m^-1) upper root errors. Published strict positivity excludes unit roots, so local reciprocal-conjugate root pairs are simple and split one inside/one outside. Published boundary bound |Q(omega)|>=m sin^2(pi j/k), combined with factorization and leading coefficient Theta(m^3), forces the matching Omega(m^-1) lower distance. Exact script confirms formulas in finite cases, but the proof supplies all infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The fixed-gap rational exponents converge to the zero-free classical Hartogs triangle, yet each approximating Bergman kernel has k slice zeros. Counting zeros alone leaves their escape geometry unknown. The theorem identifies one persistent scalar-limit point and k-1 distinct equally spaced boundary limits, with a rigorously sharp universal Euclidean scaling and eventual simplicity. It explains precisely how an expanding zero set escapes to a collapsing oblique slice; this is a natural structural asymptotic, not a table recomputation or isolated numerical example.
